note: The engine this plugin runs bash on. Built from source at a pinned upstream commit plus this repository patch set, because the contract this plugin states depends on one behaviour upstream does not have: a pattern/script/program word is never rewritten into its Win32 spelling. `ref` is a commit because a tag can be moved; `tag` records the release it was cut from. `artifact` is the build shipped inside this package: `scripts/build-engine.mjs --refresh` replaces it and rewrites the hash. The hash is the provenance of the shipped bytes, not a reproducible-build promise: replaying the pin and the patches rebuilds the same code but not the same file, so a rebuilt engine is verified behaviourally, by `npm test` and the corpus, never by comparing hashes.
why: rubash is a from-scratch bash 5.3 engine whose own test surface is the GNU upstream suite, so almost everything this repository used to patch (a real PID behind $!, /tmp as an alias, descriptor paths, kill as a builtin, CRLF scripts, select, nameref, read -t) is correct upstream. The one behaviour still missing is the data-primary rule above, which only the WinuxCmd suite gets; patch 0001 extends it to every child class.
